title: testing team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/testing.yaml, the team layer of the testing plugin's settings. The scan keys (adapters, paths, adapter_dirs, extend, rules) are resolved by plugins/testing/scripts/resolve-config.sh, whose loader holds their full grammar; the run-e2e keys by its e2e mode, and each wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name; the write keys (tdd_refactor_step, first_test) by its write mode. Values use plain or single-quoted scalars: the scan loader refuses double quotes. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

enable.description: Adapter ids; when any is listed, only listed adapters run.

disable.description: Adapter ids that do not run; wins over enable.

include.description: Globs relative to the repository root that are scanned even under a pruned directory.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the repository root that are not scanned; wins over include.

adapter_dirs.description: Directories of consumer adapter files, relative to the repository root or starting with ~/.

project_kinds.description: Entries of the form <glob>=<kind>. A C# test project whose repository-relative .csproj path the glob matches gets that kind in /testing:audit findings, over the name and package evidence; the first match wins. Kinds live and operational add a do-not-run warning. Quote an entry that starts with *.

extend.description: Per adapter id, items appended to that adapter's list fields (files, test_start, assertion.calls and the rest the loader names).

rules.description: Rule levels: rule-<slug> (or testing/audit/rule-<slug>) and test-weaken-block, each off, warn or error.

e2e_driver.description: Who drives a /testing:run-e2e run. auto picks harness when a spec or script covers the changed flow, run for a CLI, TUI or service, and playwright for a browser; chrome is attended runs only.

reuse_running_instance.description: Whether /testing:run-e2e drives an app that already answers. true, and auto when attended, reuse it. With a Workspace environment entry, false and unattended auto start the run's own instance through up and info instead; with no entry, unattended auto reuses it with labeled evidence and false stops with the gap report.

browser_driver.description: The command name of the one browser tool a /testing:run-e2e playwright drive uses. When the driver chosen for the run is playwright (pinned or picked by auto) and this command is not on PATH, the run stops before driving, naming this key, the value and its source; it never switches tools. Any other value is named and the key takes its default.

tdd_refactor_step.description: Whether /testing:write runs the Refactor step after each green and reports it as a line beginning 'Refactor checkpoint:' (what it tidied, or why nothing needed it). off goes from green to the next test. Set here or in .claude/testing.local.yaml only; it has no userConfig option. Quote the value ('on') for a YAML 1.1 tool that reads a bare on as a boolean.

first_test.description: Which test /testing:write writes first when the change has acceptance criteria and a user-visible flow. user-flow starts with the critical user-flow test and works inside it; unit starts with a unit test of the first behavior and still writes the user-flow test before the task is done. Set here or in .claude/testing.local.yaml only; it has no userConfig option.

pixel_tolerance.description: How many pixels per image /testing:check-visual-parity accepts as differing from the baseline. Read from origin's default branch; ~/.claude/testing.yaml, .claude/testing.local.yaml and the pixel_tolerance userConfig option can only lower it. Quote a reason that holds a colon followed by a space.

pixels.description: Differing pixels accepted per image; 0 fails on any differing pixel.

reason.description: Why the team accepts that many differing pixels; required when pixels is above 0.
